Home.title: Museu da Lourinhã
Home.welcome: Where Late Jurassic dinosaurs meet the history and traditions of the Portuguese coast.

Hero.tagline: Where Jurassic dinosaurs meet the sea.
Hero.lead: Palaeontology, archaeology, ethnography and a Jurassic garden — one museum, eight centuries of stories waiting for you.

Highlights.heading: Four collections, one story
Highlights.subtitle: Each wing of the museum reveals a layer of the Lourinhã territory — from the deep Jurassic sea to everyday crafts.
